html: כדר (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic كَدَرَ vii. shoot or fish down (of hawk, star, etc.; also of an attacking force) so Thes Fl in De Job 15, 24 Buhl Di al.; v. also mod. Arabic كدّر annoy, vex, reprimand, SpiroVocab; كدر oftener be dark, gloomy, turbid, whence > כידור = seething tumult, of battle, cf. Köii, 147, § 71. 1).
